items.title: Holly Hofmann interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998
items.q: Oh, yeah. Those were the years of the Basie band.

ctx.x: He really gave the Basie thing another sound to work with and inspired all those cool arrangements.
